description: Minified JavaScript source for jQuery UI Button widget version 1.14.1, defining the button widget, its options, methods, and behaviors.

classes.name: ui.button
classes.description: jQuery UI Button widget definition, including options, creation, enhancement, icon management, and state updates.

methods.name: _getCreateOptions
methods.description: Retrieves initial options for the button widget based on element attributes and existing state.

methods.name: _create
methods.description: Initializes the button widget, setting up classes, labels, icons, and event handlers.

methods.name: _enhance
methods.description: Enhances the element to behave as a button, setting roles and icons.

methods.name: _updateTooltip
methods.description: Updates the tooltip based on label and title options.

methods.name: _updateIcon
methods.description: Updates the icon element within the button based on options.

methods.name: _destroy
methods.description: Cleans up the widget, removing added attributes and elements.

methods.name: _attachIcon
methods.description: Attaches icon element to the button.

methods.name: _setOptions
methods.description: Sets multiple options at once, updating icon and label as needed.

methods.name: _setOption
methods.description: Sets a single option and updates the button's appearance accordingly.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the button state, especially disabled state.
